_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Searching for wedding vendors on Zola
_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Interactive carousel displaying wedding vendor search results. Shows vendor cards with photos, name, location, ratings, price tier, and a 'Get a quote' button linking to Zola.

description: Use this when the user wants to find or compare wedding vendors in the United States: venues, photographers, videographers, florists, bands and DJs, hair and makeup, caterers, cakes and desserts, planners, bar services, officiants, and other services such as attire, dance floors, and floral preservation. Searches Zola's vendor listings by vendor type, city or state, starting price, venue capacity, style filters, and wedding date. Gives up to 20 vendors, each with its name, location, starting price, slug for zola_get_vendor_details, and vendor page on zola.com, and shows them in a carousel with photos and ratings. Do not use for general wedding planning advice, for vendors outside the United States, or to book or pay a vendor: Zola does not book or take payment here, and the vendor page has the quote request. Do not use for the couple's own booked vendors: use zola_list_my_booked_vendors.

city.description: A US city, for example 'Austin'. Give state too

filters.description:
Map of filter keys to arrays of filter values. Available filters vary by vendor_type. Can be null or omitted if no filters are needed.

venue filters:
- "venue-service-level": ["venue-service-level-all-inclusive", "venue-service-level-limited-services", "venue-service-level-raw-space"]
- "venue-setting": ["venue-setting-indoor-space", "venue-setting-outdoor-space", "venue-setting-covered-outdoor-space"]
- "target-couple-venue-preference": ["target-couple-venue-preference-farms-barns-ranches", "target-couple-venue-preference-vineyards-wineries", "target-couple-venue-preference-beaches-waterfronts", "target-couple-venue-preference-hotels-inns-resorts", "target-couple-venue-preference-ballrooms-banquet-halls", "target-couple-venue-preference-parks-gardens", "target-couple-venue-preference-historic-estates-mansions", etc.]
- "services-offered": ["services-offered-catering-services", "services-offered-bar-services", "services-offered-on-site-accomodations", "services-offered-wheelchair-accessible", "services-offered-pet-friendly", etc.]

photographer filters:
- "photography-style": ["photography-style-photojournalistic", "photography-style-fine-art", "photography-style-editorial", "photography-style-classic"]
- "package-components-services-offered": ["package-components-services-offered-engagement-shoot", "package-components-services-offered-second-shooter", "package-components-services-offered-drone", etc.]
- "hours-offered": ["hours-offered-6-hours", "hours-offered-7-hours", "hours-offered-8-hours", "hours-offered-9-hours", "hours-offered-10-hours"]

videographer filters:
- "videography-style": ["videography-style-cinematic", "videography-style-documentary", "videography-style-storytelling", "videography-style-vintage", "videography-style-classic"]
- "videographer-deliverables": ["videographer-deliverables-highlight-reel", "videographer-deliverables-raw-footage", "videographer-deliverables-social-media-sharing", etc.]

florist filters:
- "florist-service-level": ["florist-service-level-full-service-floral-design", "florist-service-level-a-la-carte", "florist-service-level-wholesale"]
- "florist-style": ["florist-style-romantic", "florist-style-modern", "florist-style-bohemian", "florist-style-classic", "florist-style-garden-inspired", "florist-style-alternative-non-traditional"]
- "florist-floral-arrangement": ["florist-floral-arrangement-bouquets", "florist-floral-arrangement-centerpieces", "florist-floral-arrangement-ceremony-decor", etc.]

limit.description: Number of vendors to return, from 1 to 20. Default 8

max_price_cents.description: The highest starting price, in US cents, from 0 to 1,000,000,000: $5,000 is 500000

max_venue_capacity.description: The highest guest capacity of the venue, from 0 to 100,000. Only with vendor_type venue

min_price_cents.description: The lowest starting price, in US cents, from 0 to 1,000,000,000: $5,000 is 500000

min_venue_capacity.description: The lowest guest capacity of the venue, from 0 to 100,000. Only with vendor_type venue

offset.description: Vendors to skip, for the next page, from 0 to 200. Default 0

state.description: The 2-letter US state code, for example 'TX'

target_dates.description: The wedding dates, YYYY-MM-DD, for example ['2027-06-12']

vendor_type.description: Type of wedding vendor to search for

name: zola_search_vendors

outputSchema.description: Vendor search results - full vendor details available in widget

location_candidates.description: The places that match the city, with ambiguous_location

status.description: Why there are no vendors: Zola has no location for the city, or more than one place has the name

city.description: City where the vendor is based

state.description: State where the vendor is based

title: Search Zola Wedding Vendors
